instruction: Candid medium close-up of two young girls in a sunny park. On the left, the curly-haired girl in a white cardigan and reddish-brown overalls (R1) smiles widely at the camera. On the right, the girl with a pink headband in a blue shirt and pink cardigan (R2) leans her head close to R1, smiling. They stand close together with R2's arm wrapped around R1's shoulder. Warm, bright golden hour sunlight filters through the trees behind them.
